A '''hut''' in the northern [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] was the residence of the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] master [[armorsmith]] [[Mol Ni'mai]]. It was circular in shape and made of stone with a rounded doorway. An [[Dantooine base/Legends|abandoned Rebel base]] on the planet was within visual range of the hut. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] and fellow armorsmith visited Ni'mai's mountaintop home, hoping to learn the secret to creating the Bothan's greatest invention, the [[Reinforced Insulated Sheath armor]]. Ni'mai was initially skeptical of the spacer's [[Armor/Legends|armor]] crafting abilities, but after a payment of 50,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] he instructed the spacer on how to construct the armor.<ref name="SWG:P4" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mol Ni'mai's hut appeared as an explorable location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:P4" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The hut, along with its inhabitant Mol Ni'mai, were added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 4 Notes: 13 November 03|Publish 4]]," released on [[November 13]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 4 Mounts and Cities">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60891|text=Publish 4 Mounts and Cities}}</ref> A player of the Munitions [[Merchant/Legends|Trader]] profession, which included the ability to craft armor, might visit this location and take on a quest from Ni'mai that would teach them to create the Reinforced Insulated Sheath armor.<ref name="SWG:P4" />
